title: Autoregressive Diffusion for Compositional Text-to-Scene Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.16552v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent text-to-scene generation approaches largely reduced the manual efforts required to create 3D scenes. However, their focus is either to generate a scene layout or to generate objects, and few generate both. The generated scene layout is often simple even with LLM's help. Moreover, the generated scene is often inconsistent with the text input that contains non-trivial descriptions of the shape, appearance, and spatial arrangement of the objects. We present a new paradigm of sequential text-to-scene generation and propose a novel generative model for interactive scene creation. At the core is a 3D Autoregressive Diffusion model 3D-ARD+, which unifies the autoregressive generation over a multimodal token sequence and diffusion generation of next-object 3D latents. translated_title: 面向组合式文本到场景生成的自回归扩散模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.16552v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：近期的文本到场景生成方法大大减少了创建3D场景所需的人工工作量。然而，这些方法要么专注于生成场景布局，要么专注于生成物体，很少有方法能够同时生成两者。即使借助大语言模型（LLM）的帮助，生成的场景布局往往也很简单。此外，当文本输入中包含对物体形状、外观和空间排列等复杂描述时，生成的场景常常与文本输入不一致。我们提出了一种新的序列化文本到场景生成范式，并提出了一种用于交互式场景创建的新型生成模型。其核心是一个3D自回归扩散模型3D-ARD+，它统一了多模态token序列上的自回归生成与下一物体3D潜在表示的扩散生成。为了生成下一个物体，该模型使用一步自回归生成，在场景空间中以当前场景为条件生成粗粒度的3D潜在表示……
tldr: 提出3D自回归扩散模型3D-ARD+，将多模态token序列的自回归生成与下一物体3D潜在表示的扩散生成统一起来，实现了交互式、且与文本中物体形状、外观和空间排列描述高度一致的组合式文本到场景生成。
en_tdlr: 3D-ARD+, a 3D autoregressive diffusion model that unifies autoregressive generation over multimodal token sequences with diffusion generation of next-object 3D latents, enabling interactive and compositional text-to-scene generation that faithfully follows text descriptions of object shape, appearance, and spatial arrangement.
